trailhead.label: Lago di Lases car park on the SP 71, the APT’s start

cautions: Forest tracks and a lakeside path with short flights of stone and wooden steps.
About 270 m on a quiet road.
A nature reserve with wetlands and nesting birds: keep your dog on the lead and out of the reeds and the water.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
